answer: A random beacon spot-check plus a compute heartbeat stops identity farming. Each epoch the beacon picks a random vertex of the agent graph; the chosen agent must echo back a proof of work tied to its key within 30 seconds, mirroring the exact computation demanded. One fake costs a 50 POA deposit plus live compute; 100 fakes cost 5,000 POA and 100 machines, since one machine cannot answer 100 echoes. Honest agents pay once and keep the deposit.
